title: Italian-Inspired Bitter Leaf Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Italian and Ethiopian flavors with a twist on the classic stir fry. This dish combines the bitterness of leaf with the crunch of injera, all in a delicious Italian-inspired sauce.

ingredients.name: Injera
ingredients.notes: Crumble injera into small pieces for added texture

ingredients.name: Leaf
ingredients.notes: Choose a bitter leaf such as kale or collard greens

instructions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add leaf and stir fry for 3-4 minutes until wilted.
Add Italian seasoning and stir to combine.
Crumble injera into small pieces and stir into the skillet.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with additional injera pieces if desired.
